inputs.text: Open your eyes. The official narrative about the DHS announcing the arrest of an illegal immigrant gang member by ICE after he was released by New York City authorities despite posing a danger to public safety is nothing more than a carefully orchestrated theatrical production designed to distract the public. They want us to believe this is just about tensions between sanctuary policies and federal immigration enforcement, with DHS criticizing the city's actions and pointing to the potential public safety risks of releasing individuals with criminal records. But don't fall for the surface-level deception. This manufactured conflict between local and federal branches is just a smoke screen masking how the hidden elites tightly control both sides to manipulate the population and advance their agenda.
